title: Episode title cards
description: What each episode's title card says besides its English title (which is the episode file's own `title`). Keyed by episode id. Read by tools/title-sequence/titleseq/card.py, which fills data/title-sequences/episode-card.json with it.

number.description: The episode's number in the session order.

numberJa.description: The number in the old formal numerals: 第壱話, 第弐話, 第参話...
